answer: The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in marble, expire in meadow, and voyage lists each expiry. Anyone running 64 aliases as a result needs 125 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3868 identities would post 4814 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
